issues.description: Critical severity SAST (Static Application Security Testing) issues in your code files should not be present.

issues.name: High severity static analyzer (SAST) alerts should not occur
issues.description: High severity SAST (Static Application Security Testing) issues in your code files should not be present.

issues.name: Medium severity static analyzer (SAST) alerts should not occur
issues.description: Medium severity SAST (Static Application Security Testing) issues in your code files should not be present.

issues.name: All languages should be covered by SAST
issues.description: The approved SAST (Static Application Security Testing) application should scan all code files regardless of language.

issues.name: High severity open source (SCA) alerts should not occur
issues.description: High severity SCA (Software Composition Analysis) issues should not be present.

issues.name: Medium severity open source (SCA) alerts should not occur
issues.description: Medium severity SCA (Software Composition Analysis) issues should not be present.

issues.name: Critical severity open source (SCA) alerts should not occur
issues.description: Critical severity SCA (Software Composition Analysis) issues should not be present.

issues.name: All languages should be covered by open source scan (SCA)
issues.description: The approved SCA (Software Composition Analysis) application should scan all dependencies regardless of language.

issues.name: Appoxalypse severity secret alerts should not occur
issues.description: Appoxalypse severity secret leakage issues in your code files should not be present. These are potentially the riskiest secrets present.

issues.name: Critical severity CSPM secret alerts should not occur
issues.description: Critical severity secrets should not be present in cloud deployment environments.

issues.name: High severity CSPM secret alerts should not occur
issues.description: High severity secrets should not be present in cloud deployment environments.

issues.name: High severity secret alerts should not occur
issues.description: High severity secret leakage issues in your code files should not be present.

issues.name: Critical severity secret alerts should not occur
issues.description: Critical severity secret leakage issues in your code files should not be present.

issues.name: Medium severity secret alerts should not occur
issues.description: Medium severity secrets should not be present in cloud deployment environments.

issues.name: Every code push should trigger a CI/CD job
issues.description: Every code push should have an associated CI/CD job triggered.

issues.name: Medium severity secret alerts should not occur
issues.description: Medium severity secret leakage issues in your code files should not be present.

issues.name: Webhooks should use a secret key
issues.description: A secret should be added everytime a webhook is added or modified.

issues.name: Webhooks should use SSL/TLS
issues.description: All URLs assigned to webhooks are being accessed via SSL/TLS.

issues.name: Webhook URLs must not have malicious reputation
issues.description: A webhook URL should not be malicious based on Virus Total reputation.

issues.name: Webhook URLs must not have suspicious reputation
issues.description: A webhook URL should not be suspicious based on Virus Total reputation.

issues.name: Webhook URLs must not have unknown reputation
issues.description: A webhook URL should not be unknown based on Virus Total reputation.
